items.title: NFL and AWS Big Data Bowl will bridge the gap from college to the pros
items.summary: The ninth annual Big Data Bowl, the NFL's flagship analytics competition, is taking a new direction. For the first time, participants will work with data that spans the full arc of a player's journey into the NFL, combining college statistics, player tracking data from the NFL Scouting Combine, and Next Generation (Next Gen) Stats from their rookie seasons. The challenge is to find the connections that link what a player does before the league to what they do after they arrive. Join the 2027 Big Data Bowl and start exploring the data.
items.creator: Ari Entin
